projected_costs._premium_basis: Declared basis: Fargate web (x86) 50, Fargate worker (x86) 31, RDS db.t4g.micro single-AZ 14. Premium = Balanced 95 + 12 RDS Multi-AZ uplift (14 -> 26 at the cached Multi-AZ rate: 0.032 x 730 + 10 GB x 0.23 = 25.66 ~ 26) = 107; Fargate is task-size driven (no uplift) and no other line has an AZ-rate variant.
projected_costs._optimized_basis: Eligible subtotal 81 = Fargate web 50 + Fargate worker 31 (Compute Savings Plan 0.30, the 1-year no-upfront mid-point of 20-40%: 50 x 0.30 = 15, 31 x 0.30 = 9.3 ~ 9 -> 24); ineligible subtotal 14 unchanged (RDS 14). RDS db.t4g.micro 14 is ineligible for the Database Savings Plan: it is Generation 4 and Database Savings Plans cover Generation 7 and newer instances only (AWS Savings Plans FAQ, read 2026-11-27); a Generation 7+ class (for example db.m7g or db.r7g) would qualify at 0.20. 95 - 24 = 71.
